title: Checkpoint: parallel lists
prompt: Implement `ArrayList<String> topScorers(ArrayList<String> names, ArrayList<Integer> scores, int cutoff)`: return a new list of every name whose matching score (same index) is strictly greater than cutoff, in order. The two lists have equal length.

tests.name: parallel scan
tests.hint: One indexed loop over both lists; score.get(i) > cutoff decides.
